{{Quote|By the Force, we create this light in the memory of those that have fallen&mdash;and in the hope that Master Draco will find his way back to us. May the Force be with them&mdash;and with us.|Emperor Roan Fel, during a remembrance ceremony for the brown-haired Imperial Knight and several others|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|brown]]-haired '''Human male''' was an [[Imperial Knight]] in [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he journeyed with [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], serving as one of many [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] while Fel conducted [[Mission to Agamar|peace talks]] with members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. When a group of [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attacked]] the meeting, the Imperial Knights and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fought back. The brown-haired [[Gender/Legends|male]] was one of several Knights who [[Death/Legends|died]] during the combat while protecting the Emperor, and a [[Funeral/Legends|remembrance ceremony]] was later held to honor him and the rest of the fallen.

==Biography==
{{Quote|That's the last of them, Bokar. These two are dead. Still no sign of Fel.|Yuln, speaking of the corpses of the brown-haired male and one other Imperial Knight|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
In [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]],<ref name="Legacy 46" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with light skin and short [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s,<ref name="Legacy 48" /> an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] loyal to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The Emperor [[Mission to Agamar|traveled]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] to conduct peace talks with members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]],<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref> and the brown-haired male was one<ref name="Legacy 48" /> of many Imperial Knights who accompanied Fel as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. As the Imperial delegation met with several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on Agamar's [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains and negotiated an alliance against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]], the proceedings were interrupted by a group of [[One Sith|Sith]] who ascended from nearby swamps and [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attacked]]. The Imperial Knights and Jedi stood together and defended the Emperor,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> but several of their numbers, including the brown-haired male, [[Death/Legends|died]] in the melee.<ref name="Legacy 48" /> Most of the survivors were able to evacuate the battleground in the escape [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Defender One]]''.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

The brown-haired male's corpse lay on the ground with a wound in its forehead. [[138 ABY|Three days]] after the attack, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Bokar]] and [[Yuln]] came across it and the corpse of a [[Unidentified female Imperial Knight (Agamar corpse)|female Imperial Knight]] while searching for survivors.<ref name="Legacy 48" /> Shortly thereafter, Fel held a [[Imperial Knight remembrance ceremony|remembrance ceremony]] on the Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] in part to honor all of the Imperial Knights who died on Agamar.<ref name="Legacy War 1">[[Legacy — War 1|''Legacy — War'' 1]]</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|And many Jedi and Imperial Knights died, Yuln, proving they are ''weaker'' than the Sith.|Bokar, on the battle that saw the death of the brown-haired male|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
As an Imperial Knight, the brown-haired male was part of an organization<ref name="Legacy 48" /> whose members were considered to be among the most talented and dangerous [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" /> Despite this, he did not survive battle with the Sith on Agamar.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Eightfarmers.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Eight "farmers" tend to a field.]]
The brown-haired male's corpse appeared in a single panel of the [[Legacy (2006) 48|forty-eighth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', which depicted the aftermath of the battle on Agamar.<ref name="Legacy 48" /> Three months prior, ''Legacy''{{'s}} [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-fifth issue]] showed eight [[Agamarian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] tending to a field close to the peace talks between the Imperial Knights and Jedi,<ref name="Legacy 45" /> and in the [[Legacy (2006) 46|following issue]], five of those farmers shed their robes and revealed themselves to be Imperial Knights in disguise.<ref name="Legacy 46" /> Although ''Legacy 48'' introduced two additional Imperial Knights who fought in the battle,<ref name="Legacy 48" /> neither the brown-haired male nor the female whose corpse he lay next to have been explicitly confirmed to have been one of the other three farmers. All three issues were written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /><ref name="Legacy 48" /><ref name="Legacy 45" />
